title: ukpga_20160002_en.pdf — section 72
text:
51 Forfeiture of seized ite ms by court on application

(1) A relevant enforcement officer may apply to the approp riate court for the
forfeiture of an item retained under section 49.

(2) Where an application for the forfeiture of an item is made under this section,
the item is to be retained while proceedings on the application are in progress.

(3) If the court is satisfied that—
(a) the item is a psychoactive substanc e which, if it had not been seized,
was likely to be consumed by an individual for its psychoactive effects,
and
(b) at the time of its seizure, the item was not being used for the purposes
of, or in connection with, an exempt ed activity (see subsection (12))
carried on by a person entitled to the item,
the court must order the forfeiture of the item.

(4) If the item is not a psychoactive subs tance, the court may order the forfeiture
of the item if satisfied that it has been used in the commission of an offence
under this Act.
